description: Spike: operator-theoretic Faddeev pentagon route to λ_scale. N=16-dim truncated Heisenberg rep with U = h_q · diag(q^(2k)), V = strict upper-shift; satisfies U·V = q²·V·U on the open block (verified to ~10⁻⁵⁰). Computes Φ_q(U), Φ_q(V), Φ_q(U·V) via spectral / nilpotent calculus, records the pentagon-identity matrix-norm residual (reported absolute; large due to high-eigenvalue entries — the (0,0) entries agree to 10 digits, see audit doc § Known issues), then probes a substrate-natural family of scalar invariants (diagonal matrix elements, traces, ratios) for ppb-precision matches to λ_p = 2.4599527843613… (CODATA). Companion to PR #923/#928/#941 cumulative CAL-4 audit — operator-theoretic route is the hardest of the four structurally-distinct paths.
